beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part two of the Musinique logo. Four moves: a clip-path mask reveal, a scale push from eight times down to fit, a rotation spring, and a blur-in. All four are transforms. The difference is what they suggest about the camera.

Your turn. Paste this: wipe my logo left to right with a clip-path mask, then follow it with a scale zoom from eight times — and tell me which one says cinematic and which one says product. One frame is a curtain; the other is a camera.
Musinique logo, in motion. Part two. Liam, in for Bear.
